text:
elaine: Quick sync — need final decisions for the GA readiness playbook by EOD. Top items: SLA tiers, docs checklist, oncall coverage, pricing guardrails, monitoring alerts. Who can own each?

mohit: I can take SLA tiers and SLO targets. Proposal: 99.9% p99 latency for Hosted, 99.95% for Dedicated. Will draft rationale (capacity, multitenancy risk, reserved throughput).

sam-docs: I9ll own docs checklist. Can someone confirm minimum sections: Quickstart, API changes, SDK examples, Rollback steps, Troubleshooting (latency/caching)?

lisa-finance: Pricing guardrails I'm on. Need baseline cost per 1M tokens, reserve discount bands, and a burst-cap policy (soft throttle + billing cap). Also want a clear sentence about refunds vs credits.

jordan-oncall: Oncall coverage: plan is 24/7 for Sev1, weekday daytime for Sev2. Need a defined escalation path and a primary for Dedicated incidents. Also we should add a warm handoff checklist.

neha-legal: Quick flag — any customer-facing SLA that mentions credits needs legal-approved template. I can fast-track review if the language is tight and the credit calc is deterministic.

mohit: For Dedicated incident ownership, suggest primary = customer-eng (first 30m), fallback = infra oncall, and automatic fallback routing to Hosted-compatible model if Dedicated pool insufficient. I9ll add to the rollout doc.

sam-docs: Draft checklist (minimal):
- What9s included in GA (endpoints/features)
- Config defaults and recommended limits
- SLA summary (link to legal template)
- Runbook snippets for common failures
- How to opt into Dedicated / Private

elaine: Monitoring: need four alert classes — latency regression, error spike, capacity fill, billing anomaly. Who owns thresholds and playbooks?

mohit: Eng-runtime will own latency and error thresholds. I9ll add a staging-to-prod baseline, and an automated suppression window during rollouts to avoid noisy alerts.

jordan-oncall: Add a runbook link to each alert and include a simulated playbook for staging runthroughs. We should rehearse once before GA. :white_check_mark:

lisa-finance: Billing-anomaly alerts should go to finance+product+infra, and include an estimated $/hr burn delta. Also ask for a weekly spike digest for finance.

neha-legal: Also flag privacy-sensitive monitoring — logs must redact customer content and PII. I9ll add required wording for telemetry retention.

sam-docs: I9ll include a short "on first alert" snippet and link to the escalation matrix in the docs PR.

elaine: Ownership recap: SLA: mohIt; Docs: sam-docs; Pricing: lisa-finance; Oncall: jordan-oncall; Legal sign-off: neha-legal; Monitoring hooks: mohIt+jordan-oncall. If no objections by 16:30 we9ll lock and publish the playbook draft by 18:00.

mohit: Agree. Will upload SLA draft to drive and link here.

lisa-finance: Agree, will provide pricing ranges and burst policy wording.

jordan-oncall: Agree, will prepare escalation matrix and rehearsal plan.

sam-docs: Agree. Starting doc PR and will tag reviewers.

neha-legal: I9ll review the credits template once posted.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: ga-readiness-playbook-draft -> staging at 2024-06-07T17:00Z :rocket:

elaine: Thanks all — if no objections by 16:30 I9ll mark owners final and create the playbook PR. :thumbsup:
